messages: Ava (Design): quick UX check — in the compact batch preview the legend (vectors, embeddings, rerank score) is collapsing on narrow widths. thinking: move legend into sticky header or use a collapsible legend icon? Zach (Eng): sticky header sounds fine. less DOM churn than a collapse panel. will that impact keyboard nav? Carmen (A11y): if it's sticky we must ensure legend items are reachable via keyboard and have descriptive aria-labels. right now the color squares have no accessible name. Ava (Design): agreed — spec would be: visible labels + color swatches, and for screen readers `aria-label="Score: high"` etc. also consider a text-only toggle for high-contrast mode. Jon (PM): tiny product note — users export CSV a lot; if we move legend into header, we should keep export and bulk actions grouped so workflows stay one-click. last time we scattered buttons and support tickets went up. Zach (Eng): got it. header left: legend toggle, center: density control, right: export + bulk actions. can do. Liam (ML): question on copy — the rerank score currently shows "0.83" with no context. maybe show "score (0-1)" tooltip? non-technical users ask what the range is. Ava (Design): yep, tooltip copy: "Rerank score (0–1): higher means more relevant to the query." Carmen, any concerns for screen readers? Carmen (A11y): tooltips need accessible alternatives. prefer `aria-describedby` on the score cell pointing to visually-hidden explanatory text. sample: `Rerank score from 0 to 1; higher is more relevant`. avoid tooltips that disappear on focus out. Zach (Eng): thumbs up. I'll add an sr-only element. one implementation Q: should the score have a `role="status"` when it updates live? might spam screen readers. Carmen (A11y): don't use status for every cell update. if we update the whole row on re-rank, use a polite live region that summarizes "Row 4 updated: score increased" — otherwise nothing. Ava (Design): copy tweak for export modal: current label is "Download vectors" -> change to "Export vectors (CSV)" and subtext: "Includes id, vector dims (truncated), rerank_score". keeps expectation clear. Jon (PM): +1. also add a warning if export size > 10k rows and suggest sampling. Liam (ML): sampling UX: add a sampling dropdown (first, random, stratified) with small description. default: random sample of 1000. Zach (Eng): bringing performance up — rendering 10k rows in preview kills the DOM. we'll keep preview to 100 rows and show a banner: "Previewing 100 of 10,000 rows — export will include all unless sampled". Ava (Design): Banner copy look: "Previewing 100 of 10,000 vectors. Export all or choose a sample." Carmen — banner needs role=note and a dismissible close button accessible by keyboard. Carmen (A11y): yep. close button `aria-label="Dismiss preview notice"`. make sure the banner is focusable and doesn't trap keyboard. Zach (Eng): accessibility nit — color only legend won't pass contrast. should include text or shape variants. Ava (Design): change legend items to include short text labels next to swatches and an optional inline icon (dot, square, triangle) as a non-color cue. Jon (PM): also asking from analytics side — can we expose the selected density (compact/comfortable) as a user preference so product teams can track adoption? Zach (Eng): we can emit an event on toggle, yes. Liam (ML): UI detail — vector dims shown as "[768]" currently. for long dims we should truncate to "[768 dims]" and on hover show full count. avoids overflowing table. Ava (Design): good. microcopy for help tooltip: "Dimension count = vector length; used for model compatibility." Carmen (A11y): hover-only info is inaccessible; provide `aria-describedby` target for keyboard focus too. ui-bot: deploy-preview updated for branch `design/compact-batch-legend` — staging URL: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/compact-batch-legend Zach (Eng): pinging to see if folks can test staging on macOS + VoiceOver and Windows + NVDA. I'll add a checklist in the PR. Ava (Design): I'll run a quick keyboard pass and validate copy. leaving a few TODOs on the mock: 1) legend accessible names, 2) banner dismiss semantics, 3) export modal copy + sampling options. Jon (PM): timeline — aim to ship next week behind feature flag. any blockers? Carmen (A11y): blocking until the aria-describedby and live region approach is in PR, but otherwise fine. Zach (Eng): will open PR EOD. Ava (Design): thanks everyone. adding these notes to the design doc and will flag the PR once ready. :thumbsup:
